streaming_comparison.title: Streaming methods (native online mode)
streaming_comparison.caption: All methods driven incrementally. Throughput (Eff.FPS) is included so the real-time claim is checkable against the 2.5 Hz capture rate.

offline_upper_bound.title: Full-batch offline upper bound
offline_upper_bound.caption: Feed-forward methods ingesting all views at once — an upper bound, not a like-for-like competitor to a streaming engine.

alignment_study.title: Alignment-group study
alignment_study.caption: Same backbone, fusion and trajectory; only the submap registration group varies.

alignment_by_motion.title: Alignment group stratified by motion (2 Hz)
alignment_by_motion.caption: Where the group choice actually matters: SL(4) leads on open paths and loses on loops.

ate_by_motion.title: ATE by motion family, all methods (2 Hz)
ate_by_motion.caption: Trajectory accuracy split by smooth / stop-and-go / loop.

per_method_aggregate.title: Per-method aggregate (clean, seeded, complete runs only)
per_method_aggregate.caption: Replaces the contaminated 'Global aggregate'.

headline_errorbars.title: Headline metrics with error bars
headline_errorbars.caption: Pooled mean ± within-cell seed std; the ± isolates seed noise from scene/motion heterogeneity.

seed_repeatability.title: Seed repeatability
seed_repeatability.caption: How much each metric moves when only the render seed changes.

paired_head_to_head.title: Paired head-to-head
paired_head_to_head.caption: Runs matched on (scene, traj) and differenced, cancelling scene/motion spread.

completion.title: Run completion / failure rate
completion.caption: How many runs each method actually finished. Read this before any mean.

vram_vs_sequence_length.title: Peak VRAM vs sequence length
vram_vs_sequence_length.caption: The deployability figure: streaming stays bounded, full-batch grows.
